message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build 8Vim
run-name: Build 8VIM ${{inputs.target}}

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      target:
        default: debug
        type: string
      ref:
        type: string
        required: true
      pr:
        type: number
      sha:
        type: string
      cache-read-only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
    outputs:
      artifact-id:
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.artifact-id }}
jobs:
  build:
    name: "Build app: ${{inputs.target}}"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      artifact-id: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
    steps:
      - name: Get gradle command
        id: gradle
        run: |
          case "${{inputs.target}}" in
            debug)
              echo "cmd=assembleDebug" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            release)
              echo "cmd=assembleRelease" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            rc)
              echo "cmd=assembleRc" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            *)
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{inputs.ref}}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup PR number
        if: ${{inputs.target == 'debug'}}
        run: |
          echo "" >> 8vim/version.properties
          echo "PR=${{inputs.pr}}" >> 8vim/version.properties
          echo "SHA=${{inputs.sha}}" >> 8vim/version.properties
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "17"
          distribution: temurin
      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          cache-read-only: ${{inputs.cache-read-only}}
      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}
      - name: Get keystore
        if: ${{ inputs.target != 'debug'}}
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.SIGNING_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" > keystore-b64.txt
          base64 -d keystore-b64.txt > 8vim/8vim.jks
      - name: Build APK
        env:
          VIM8_BUILD_KEYSTORE_FILE: ./8vim.jks
          VIM8_BUILD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.VIM8_BUILD_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          VIM8_BUILD_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.VIM8_BUILD_KEY_ALIAS }}
          VIM8_BUILD_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.VIM8_BUILD_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: ./gradlew ${{steps.gradle.outputs.cmd}}
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        id: upload
        with:
          name: artifact-${{inputs.target}}
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            8vim/build/outputs/*/${{inputs.target}}/8vim-${{inputs.target}}.*
            8vim/build/outputs/mapping/${{inputs.target}}/mapping.txt
          retention-days: 1
          overwrite: true",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a reusable Gradle-based Android build that repeatedly fetches dependencies. The measured experiment evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) shows adding an explicit actions/cache step for ~/.gradle/caches after setup-gradle, keyed on gradle files and the wrapper properties, reduced median elapsed CI time by ~20.4% with all runs still succeeding. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs and the cache key includes lockfile/wrapper inputs. No contraindications apply: the cached content is standard Gradle dependency cache, no equivalent explicit actions/cache step already exists, and no new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or deployment operations are introduced. All existing build steps, required checks, and artifact outputs are preserved unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
